visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The woman holds a crochet instruction book titled "Kawaii Crochet Garden" in the passenger seat of a moving car. She has dark hair with bangs and wears a striped tank top. She points specifically to a picture of a crochet cactus in a white and green pot. Natural daylight fills the car interior. (2) She opens a black zippered bag containing several balls of colorful yarn, including shades of green, brown, and pink. She begins the crochet process using a red-handled hook, working on a green circular base. The camera uses fast cuts to show her progress in a montage style. (3) As the car enters the Snow Mountain Tunnel, the lighting transitions to a dim yellow hue. She continues her handiwork, crocheting the white trim and brown soil part of the plant. A child is seen sleeping in a car seat in the background behind her shoulder. (4) The car emerges from the tunnel into bright sunlight, passing through mountainous terrain on a highway. She stuffs the crochet pot and begins working on the green cactus body. On the return trip through the tunnel, she focuses on a small pink flower. (5) She meticulously trims white yarn to create spines on the green cactus surface. Finally, she presents the completed crochet cactus in its pot to the camera, rotating it to show all sides while smiling broadly with high energy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice speaks with rapid, high-pitched intonation, describing her crochet project. An upbeat, medium-tempo pop BGM with female English vocals plays underneath. The background noise is clean with very faint road rumble. (2) As the video transitions into a fast-cut montage, the audio cuts are tight and follow the visual rhythm. The BGM remains consistent, maintaining high energy. Occasional soft plastic rustling from yarn bags is audible. (3) The acoustic environment shifts slightly as the car enters the tunnel, creating a faint resonant hum, though the voice and music remain dominant. The speaker's excitement remains high as she notes the progress. (4) The BGM continues through the final stages of the project. Transition sound effects like subtle whooshes accompany the jump cuts. The video ends with an enthusiastic exclamation from the speaker as she reveals the finished product.
